summary: Dineamic is a Keysborough ready-meal maker (est. 2008) selling direct, via stockists including Coles and Woolworths, and to NDIS and Home Care providers. Davide Sofia is Financial Controller and Demand Planner; Linc Douglas is Financial Coordinator.

claims.text: Dineamic is a Keysborough, Victoria ready-meal maker founded in 2008 that delivers fresh meals and sells through stores and stockists.
claims.quote: Buy online for delivery to your door, from our stores, or stockists.

claims.text: Davide Sofia is Financial Controller & Demand Planner at Dineamic, current since January 2022 (at the company since August 2017).
Davide gained CPA Australia associate membership (ASA) in July 2025.
Dineamic says it is a registered NDIS provider and works with Home Care Package providers.
claims.quote: We’re a registered NDIS provider and work with Home Care Package providers too.

claims.text: Dineamic delivers fresh ready meals to over 4,000 suburbs across Australia for a flat $15 refrigerated shipping fee.
claims.quote: Enjoy fresh, ready meals delivered to over 4,000 suburbs across Australia

claims.text: Dineamic lists Coles, Woolworths and other stockists on its stockist page.
LinkedIn shows Dineamic employing 30 people, up 11.9% year on year.
Linc Douglas, a CPA, has been Financial Coordinator at Dineamic since February 2022.
Dineamic describes itself as an Australian owned manufacturer of ready meals with a focus on ethically sourced ingredients.
claims.quote: Australian owned manufacturer of ready meals with a strong focus on corporate responsibility

hooks.text: Several revenue channels (delivery, stores, supermarkets, NDIS and Home Care providers) each settle differently for a small finance team
Davide's recent CPA Australia associate membership suggests a professionalising finance function

risks.text: Finance team is two people (Davide and Linc Douglas); budget for new tooling may be limited

gaps: No posts, podcasts or press by Davide found
Accounting system not confirmed; no recent news signal
